correctness.rationale: For all n>=2 and drive j, the burning forbidden-interval condition characterizes recurrent fan words; their number is the reduced-Laplacian determinant f_(2n). A first-repeat toppling argument and path causality show support equals the maximal-height run around j. For each given interval the recurrence condition decouples into two fan tails of counts w(L-1),w(n-R). Fibonacci summation proves exact normalization and independence. Binet gives bulk mass/arm law; uniform group invariance and one lost grain per topple gives mean one. Two independent standard-library scripts check 35,044 exhaustive recurrent/addition pairs and 536 finite identities, respectively. Numerical tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete finite multivariate avalanche polynomial is a natural, previously unevaluated dynamic observable for a standard dissipative fan graph family studied for its static sandpile/Tutte properties. The exact factorization gives independent left/right avalanche reaches at every finite size, quantifies endpoint boundary corrections, and identifies a non-power-law bulk limit with a nontrivial atom at zero and explicit positive-size probabilities. It extends the usefulness of the known wheel polynomial to a structurally distinct graph family without merely recomputing an already known finite table.
